response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strengths in TypeScript, Node.js, and some low-latency backend work in DLang, but the role requires deep hardware expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, GPU architecture, and hardware-software co-design. There is no evidence of computer architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or silicon/hardware modeling experience, making this a fundamental domain mismatch despite strong general engineering tenure.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience, satisfying the BS + 8 years experience bar
Some systems-level and performance-oriented work (low-latency DLang services, async I/O, high-throughput microservices)
Demonstrated initiative through open-source projects, workshops, and technical talks
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No deep-learning training/inference optimization or GPU/SIMD/MIMD workload analysis background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, far from principal-level performance architecture for AI accelerators

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or DL workload optimization background
